similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic five-story pagoda (Goju-no-to) from the photo. It features five distinct tiers of flared roofs (using frustum_pyramid with topR < botR to ensure correct outward-downward slope), detailed wooden bracket complexes (tokyo) represented by nested structural boxes, a solid base, and the prominent golden finial (sorin) at the top. All components are tightly integrated with no gaps, and the symmetry is fully preserved across all four sides.
